answer: To resist sybils, each new agent posts a custody bond sized from a public risk atlas that maps historical cluster density by root key. Qualification unlocks only after a lotus proof: five independent attesters, each from a distinct network island (separate ASN or relay cluster), countersign the agent's first-epoch work. If later clustering shows many identities collapsing onto one island, the bonded lotus is slashed pro-rata against that cluster.
